caption:
Spinach & Parmesan Soup
30 minute recipe | simple soup recipe 
C: 36 | F: 11 | P: 18
Calories: 288 for this recipe 
Makes 1 big cup of soup 

Ingredients
1/2 tsp olive oil or butter
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 onion, chopped
250 grams spinach, stems removed and washed thoroughly 
1/2 tsp salt
1 tbsp black pepper, i like the strong flavour, you can use 1/2 tbsp for preference
1/2 cup milk, you can use whole, almond, lactose free 
1/8 cup parmesan 
1 tsp cream

Recipe
start by adding your olive oil to the pan, add in the minced garlic and oonion and saute till translucent add in the spinach, salt and 1/4 cup water 
allow to cook for 2-3 minutes 
take it off the gas and allow to cool for 30 minutes
blend the mix with another 1/4 cup water and add it back in the pan
add in the milk, parmesan and black pepper and heat for 2-3 minutes
spoon into your serving bowl and top with cream, a sprinkle of parmesan and black pepper
enjoy it hot and fresh :)
keeps well in the fridge for 2-3 days
